# Image Factory
## Plugin marketplaces
This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.
| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| Full-stack development | Full Stack Plugins | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, qual

ity checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | Full
AIGC Plugins | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |
> Turn a reference-driven image task into an auditable production run: a validated plan, an approved
spend, and a hash-verified receipt for every artifact.
English | 简体中文 · Install · Quick start · Skills · Troubleshooting
## Positioning
`image-factory` produces verifiable image batches. It turns references and a visual direction into a
validated plan, quotes the batch, waits for your approval, generates one image per plan item throug
h the host's image tool, and records a recomputed hash, size, and dimension receipt for every file.
The plugin exposes two layers. In Codex the built-in `imagegen` / `image_gen` path is preferred and
needs no provider key. The unchanged Baoyu workflows are offered only after an explicitly observed i
mage-quota exhaustion in Codex, or on a host without a verified native image capability. The Factory
loop adds the governed batch: plan validation, approval, receipts, evaluation, and recovery.

Each attempt is a fresh streaming subprocess against the built-in image tool. There is no retry loop
: a silent retry is how one bad prompt becomes a large bill. A failed item is terminal; `optimize` p
roduces a new prompt round that needs its own approval.
## What you can build
| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
| Find a direction | `prompt-search` over bundled templates | Ranked prompt directions with source a

ttribution |
| Produce a governed batch | `validate-plan` → `quote` → `run` | Per-artifact hash, siz

e, and dimension receipts |
| Keep a series consistent | `consistency_profile`, entity traits, role-

aware references | Effective prompt and reference count reported by `quote` |
| Evaluate and iterate
| `evaluate` + `image-factory-review` | Deterministic gate results, advisory dimension scores, next

-round plan |
| Recover an interrupted run | `recover` | Reconciled ledger without another generatio

n call |
| Make one ad-hoc image | Codex built-in `imagegen` | A bitmap asset outside the Factory le

|
| Make one ad-hoc image | Codex built-in `imagegen` | A bitmap asset outside the Factory ledger |
Multi-image stories declare `consistency_profile`; anchors are injected into every selected frame in
a fixed order and `story_state` compiles locks and transitions into the effective prompt. Anchors i
mprove control but cannot guarantee model-level identity.
## Architecture and security
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Component | Owns | Does not own |

| `bin/image-factory` | CLI entry point | Business rules |
| `scripts/plan_validator.py` | Closed pl

an schema, caps, idempotency keys | Prompt quality |
| `scripts/generation_runner.py` | One fresh su

bprocess per attempt | Retry policy |
| `scripts/job_ledger.py`, `scripts/receipt_store.py` | Durabl

e state, scrubbing, per-artifact re-verification | Remote lifetime |
| `skills/` (10) | Routing, gov
ernance, and review instructions | Runtime enforcement |
Authentication is Codex's own. The Factory path never calls an external generation API, never update
s an upstream dependency on its own, and never writes a credential: the ledger rejects credential-li
ke keys before writing anything. Reference inputs are validated before use, and every hash, size, an
d dimension is recomputed from disk with a second check that catches a file rewritten mid-validation
dimension is recomputed from disk with a second check that catches a file rewritten mid-validation.
